content: The Pearson correlation coefficients (r-values) are listed in Table TABREF39. The users at the top (Trump, Bachchan, Modi) all display very strong positive correlation. We name this group UPC (Users with Positive Correlation), and the group of users at the bottom (Grande, Bieber, Kardashian) as UNC (Users with Negative Correlation).
